main_body: A saddle seen in side profile (pommel, dipped seat, cantle, skirt with studs) resting on a rack with two dark legs and a ring/buckle between them
top_band: Column x=8: a light tan band at rows 14-16 (highlight #f8c090 then #da9b6e). This is the leather top profile of the saddle, with no separate horizontal surface behind it. Rows 17-18 are mid brown and rows 19-21 dark brown.
evidence: The saddle is a profile silhouette: pommel and cantle bumps with a concave seat between them. The seat curve is drawn as an edge, not as a horizontal surface seen from above. The tan region is the seat and flap seen from the side, and the skirt below it is a flat vertical band with studs. There is no distinct front-edge line and no eave shadow, and nothing is inset. The rack legs and beam are plain verticals with no top faces. This matches the red side-elevation chair in the guide.

style.evidence: The leather has about five steps (highlight #f8c090, tan #da9b6e, yellow-tan stud accent, mid brown #a0522c, dark brown #783c1f, deep outline #411e05). The outline is a dark brown tint, and only 14% of dark edge pixels are neutral. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and there are stud dots and a metal buckle in blue-grey. The 19 colours per tile are comparable to the references (17 and 20). The 20 distinct colours are below the references' 38-40 but fit the small size of the piece. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
